artifacts.name: agents-guide
artifacts.description: Authoritative project guide for agents and contributors. Project overview (canonical InfoItem + InfoSpec registry), full src/ layout, env vars (ARCHIVER_DATABASE_URL, ARCHIVER_API_KEY, TEST_DATABASE_URL), server lifecycle (port 8020=systemd, 8021=dev), commit conventions, mirrored content-acquisition code obligations vs. watcher, Phase 3a authoring tools (validate_info_spec, find_info_item, fetch_and_render, preview_extraction, propose_selectors, atomic create_info_item).

artifacts.name: readme
artifacts.description: Top-level README. Brief description of the Archiver service — sibling to watcher and notifier, consumed via archiver-client SDK. Run-locally / tests / SDK regeneration commands. Extraction history (from watcher#149) and pointer to the InfoSource trajectory research doc.

artifacts.name: skills-doc
artifacts.description: Agent skills index. Catalogues the skills under skills/ (agentskills.io) and .claude/skills/ (Claude Code). Local overrides table, vendor submodule reference, SocratiCode workflow, linked-projects config (watcher+notifier).

artifacts.name: design-and-plans
artifacts.description: Archive of design and implementation plan documents. Captures the 'why' behind each phase: Phase 1 plan (information service foundation), Information Source Specifications design, Phase 3a plan (authoring tools — validate, fetch_and_render, preview_extraction, propose_selectors, atomic create_info_item).

artifacts.name: research-trajectory
artifacts.description: Trajectory research. 2026-05-06-archiver-information-model.md describes the eventual evolution from the current InfoItem ↔ InfoSpec model (Phase 1–3a) to a content-addressed InfoSource + SourceSpec + SourceRevision model. The 'v2' anchor — implement deliberately, not in passing.

artifacts.name: alembic-migrations
artifacts.description: Database schema history as Alembic migrations (canonical source of truth — no separate schema.sql). Current migrations: create_info_specs (info_specs table — InfoSpec primary records linked to InfoItems by info_item_id) and create_info_items (info_items table — the canonical Information Item registry).

artifacts.name: systemd-unit
artifacts.description: Production systemd service unit for the Archiver API. Defines how the live service on port 8020 is launched, restarted, and which env files it loads (/etc/archiver/.env).
